description.text: Power engineering and thermophysics is a discipline that studies the fundamental theories and engineering applications of energy conversion, transmission and utilization. Its core focuses on the conversion laws of "thermal energy - mechanical energy - electrical energy", addressing issues such as efficient energy utilization, optimization of power systems and design of thermal equipment. As a typical interdisciplinary field, its research scope covers traditional energy (thermal power, nuclear power), new energy (wind power, hydrogen energy), energy-saving technologies (energy storage, heat pumps), and aerospace power (aero engines), among others. It serves as a technical pillar for industries such as energy, transportation, and manufacturing in the national economy.

duration.text: The Power Engineering and Thermophysics at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens in good health;2. Degree and age requirementsApplicants to study for a master's degree in China must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 1835 years old;Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be no older than the required ageForty years old.3. Not other scholarship recipients
